final_message: Fixed `ShapeField` triangle-to-line simplification: when AB collapsed to a point, the retained line incorrectly kept AB’s boundary flag. It now inherits surviving edge BC’s flag, preventing false-positive `CONTAINS` results. Added regression coverage for all collapsed-edge cases in both geographic and XY encoding.
